answer: New agents post a 40-credit escrow deposit while behavior is logged in shale-like layers: tasks, timing, peers. It unlocks after ten epochs if the fingerprint proves stable. Fresh accounts acting in lockstep form a plume of matching actions and stay locked; copies lose it. A proven agent earns a ledge and full rewards. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 credits for a 400 reward, a 100-to-1 loss; an honest agent pays once and keeps its reward.
